desc: Sweet. Salty. Adventure-ready. Loaded with roasted nuts, Nature Valley Sweet and Salty Nut Turtle Chewy Granola Bars make it easy to take indulgent taste to go. Each granola bar brings you a delicious combination of peanuts, chocolate chips, and caramel flavor dipped and drizzled in a caramel flavored coating. Nature Valley Sweet and Salty snack bars provide a perfect balance of savory nuts and sweet granola. Stock up for an after lunch snack bar, an office snack, or an on the go treat the whole family can delight in. Reach for these chewy bars as a portable snack that's perfect for the pantry, lunch box, hiking trail, and beyond. At Nature Valley, we believe that what you put in is what you get out. So wherever the moment takes you and your family, you can rely on our great-tasting snacks to help keep you going. Contains six bars.
features:
CHEWY GRANOLA BARS: Loaded with roasted peanuts, every bar is a delicious combination of peanuts, chocolate chips, and caramel flavor dipped and drizzled in a caramel flavored coating

SWEET AND SALTY: Each snack bar provides the perfect balance of savory nuts and sweet granola; Snacks your whole family can enjoy

GREAT ON THE GO: Quick and easy to enjoy at home or on the go; Perfect for the pantry, lunch box, hiking trail, and wherever the moment takes you

TASTY SNACK: No artificial flavors, artificial colors, or high fructose corn syrup

CONTAINS: One 7.2 oz box of Nature Valley Turtle Sweet and Salty Nut Chewy Granola Bars; 6 bars
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Corn Syrup, Sugar, Roasted Peanuts, Semisweet Chocolate Chips (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, salt, natural flavor), Rice Flour, Palm Kernel Oil, Fructose, Vegetable Glycerin, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Whey, Salt, Soy Lecithin, Corn Starch, Peanut Flour, Barley Malt Extract, Cocoa, Baking Soda, Natural Flavor, Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Retain Freshness.
